quotes.text: My eldest son, Hud, came out. And I'd never seen him do this before, ever, but he got down in the photographers' pit and was dancing and singing along to my songs. I didn't even know he knew any of the words. He once told me he turned my records off when they came on the radio. Said he was sure that sooner or later a song was gonna go: 'Goddammit, Hud!'

I'm still learning, still excited and I'm looking for trouble. But as far as me being a jolly fellow goes… Not yet.
